{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to be safe
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for conversion issues
print(f"Number of NaN in revenue after conversion: {sales_df['revenue'].isna().sum()}")

# Look at the unique values in 'revenue' to see if there are any non-numeric strings
print(f"Unique values in revenue after conversion: {sales_df['revenue'].unique()}")

# Inspect the 'status' column for any anomalies
print(f"Unique values in status: {sales_df['status'].unique()}")

# Inspect the 'converted' column
print(f"Value counts for 'converted': {sales_df['converted'].value_counts()}")"}
